name: Setup Wizard overrides carry a timeout and are re-sent before it runs out
step: Check that the Setup Wizard's servo and mixer holds are timed and refreshed
rationale:
The Setup Wizard holds a servo or a mixer axis while the pilot checks it. A hold was sent once,
without a timeout, so when the radio link or the wizard went away the FC kept the override: the servo
stayed where it was held, and the FC refused to arm while an override was on.

From API 12.10 a hold carries a timeout, and the FC drops it when the time runs out. The harness pins
that the mixer and servo write builders send the timeout as a third u16 (and the old 3-byte payload when
not asked), that the hold tracker re-sends a hold every second, before its 3 s timeout, and drops a
released hold, and that the wizard sends its holds with the timeout and re-sends them from wakeup.

--self-test drops the timeout from the builder and requires the payload check to go red.
